description: Welcome to this opulent retreat in the heart of Bastille, a haven spanning 550 m² across 4 floors, accessible by an elevator (excluding the top floor). This luxurious apartment features 6 bedrooms and 6 bathrooms, providing a rare feeling of space and privacy for an extraordinary stay.The spaceEntering this meticulously designed residence, sophistication fills the atmosphere, epitomizing Parisian elegance. Bathed in natural light, the spacious and refined rooms feature custom-made furniture and exquisite design elements.The kitchen, which can be open or closed according to your preferences, and the dining room can accommodate up to 12 people. The spacious living room, adorned with two fireplaces, creates a warm and inviting atmosphere, perfect for relaxation and socializing.The master bedroom offers exceptional comfort with a coffee machine for your morning pleasure. You will also find a spacious walk-in closet for all your belongings. The en-suite bathroom is a true haven, equipped with a very large bathtub and a hammam with two showers. The 240x240 cm super king-size bed ensures restful nights. This luxurious suite spans an area of 80 sqm.The other 5 bedrooms are equipped with high-quality bedding, and each has an ensuite bathroom with WC.An ATMOS cinema room on the lower level promises an unforgettable cinematic experience.All comforts have been considered, from high-quality bedding and linens to two washing machines, two dryers, two dishwashers, Nespresso machines, and high-speed WiFi. Toiletries are provided for your convenience.Impeccable cleanliness is ensured by daily housekeeping services.
